title: Monitor usage of Open in Excel with telemetry

en.title: Monitor usage of Open in Excel with telemetry
en.summary: Logging Open in Excel actions to telemetry makes data export events auditable, which can be critical for compliance, security investigations, and understanding how customers use Business Central.
